responsibility: Implements the x86-specific `llvm.x86.*` intrinsic surface for the Cranelift backend by lowering supported SSE, AVX, AVX2, and related operations into Cranelift IR or inline assembly when required by the hardware interface. It contains the backend’s target-specific emulation logic for x86 LLVM intrinsics, including vector lane manipulation, gather/load helpers, and diagnostic trapping for unsupported cases.
